what.text: This page follows internal displacement in Jordan, as recorded by IDMC.
In 2023, the latest year with a figure, IDMC recorded 335 new displacements by disasters: these count movements, not people.

why.text: IDMC's disaster records for Jordan list storms.
UCDP records one armed conflict for Jordan: with the Islamic State group in 2016.

when.text: IDMC records new displacements by disasters year by year, starting in 2013.
The data shows no year-end count of people still displaced.

how.text: The sources don't say where people went inside Jordan.
New displacements count movements, not people, and are shown on their own chart.
